policy_continuity.scope: All fixed accepted training starts with exact distance1..32. Same scalar predictions and complete-candidate greedy32. Matrix rows are earlier outcome, columns later outcome. Protected finite boundaries remain unknown; ever_solved_but_lost counts only proven unreachable, finite cycle or exhausted32-step budget, while ever_solved_now_unknown is separate. Proven-unreachable entry is an irreversible failure, not an inferred later cycle. A false local minimum has no legal successor predicted strictly lower, despite a true optimal child. Repeated nodes and same-goal starts are dependent. Read-only diagnosis, never sampling feedback.

graph_panel.scope: Same883 accepted training roots and all candidate point labels from prior convergence checks. No validation relationships.

retention_panel.scope: Same original128-training-layout retention bank, excluding all16 small-study layouts.

frozen_gradient_diagnosis.scope: Eight original-mixture batches replayed from a local copy of the saved RNG. Every case uses the same frozen96k model and Adam moments, not an8-step trajectory. Six weighted gradient components sum to the unchanged original Huber plus complete-candidate soft-rank. Reported Adam directions and panel changes are analytical first-order approximations, never applied. Cosine/projection measurements are local diagnostics, not causal proof or new losses. All panels and sampled relations are allowed training data; no validation/test queries or feedback.

graph_panel.scope: Same883 accepted training roots and all candidate point labels from prior convergence checks. No validation relationships.

frozen_gradient_diagnosis.scope: Eight original-mixture batches replayed from a local copy of the saved RNG. Every case uses the same frozen96k model and Adam moments, not an8-step trajectory. Six weighted gradient components sum to the unchanged original Huber plus complete-candidate soft-rank. Reported Adam directions and panel changes are analytical first-order approximations, never applied. Cosine/projection measurements are local diagnostics, not causal proof or new losses. All panels and sampled relations are allowed training data; no validation/test queries or feedback.

scope: Fixed 20% existing graph mixture, same original1000-layout relation pool, exact graph labels and candidates, Q architecture/directed_max/Huber/full-candidate soft rank/Adam learning rate/batch sizes/sampling/evaluation unchanged. Original adopted weights remain unchanged.

convergence_options.scope: Fixed 20% graph mixture, original shared Q/directed_max/Huber/full-candidate soft rank and greedy32. Inspect every accepted graph decision and all graph point labels at checkpoints; target and distance layer fit, true training teacher paths, alternative optimal/recoverable branch entry greedy, dense heldout global/adjacent order, fixed100-layout/200-goal validation, and original-training retention. No diagnostic feedback changes sampling. Preserve full milestone and improving validation weights. Mean exposure does not establish completed epochs or convergence.

uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over 100 held-out layouts; targets and within-target start pairs are dependent. Two seeds are fixed replicates, not a sample of training-seed uncertainty. Table pooled pair rates and the unweighted mean-layout changes are different estimands. Repeatedly inspected development validation is not an independent final test.
hardware: The old6k mixed checkpoints were produced on A800s; the restored40048 instance has two A100-SXM4-80GB GPUs. Python/torch2.7.1+cu128, code/model/loss/data/optimizer/sampling unchanged. A CPU interruption test verifies state restoration and read-only diagnostics; this does not assert bitwise arithmetic identity across GPU models.
evidence: Raw node reports, counters, per-query predictions, fixed-bank queries, witnesses, progress, optimizer/RNG continuation metadata and best-validation checkpoints are under the recorded remote run and local ignored runs/new_tasks_qmap/mixture_convergence/.
